dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle in a continuous arc.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth and symmetrical lateral margins with no visible structural bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Predominantly mature white with high median pixel intensity and subtle grey undertones visible through the water interface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency diffuse grey shading localized primarily toward the posterior and lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between depigmented white and light-grey regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) on the dorsal surface; a small dark circular mark is visible posterior to the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple superficial linear scars and rake marks distributed across the dorsal plane.
